# defeater kind

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:defeaterKind`](gmeow-defeaterKind.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/defeaterKind>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/inference`](../../slices/inference.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The Pollock kind of a defeating [`gmeow:StandpointClaim`](../classes/gmeow-StandpointClaim.md) — [`gmeow:defeaterRebutting`](../individuals/gmeow-defeaterRebutting.md) (attacks the conclusion) or [`gmeow:defeaterUndercutting`](../individuals/gmeow-defeaterUndercutting.md) (attacks the inferential link). NOT functional: a single claim may defeat in more than one way.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:StandpointClaim`](../classes/gmeow-StandpointClaim.md) -> [`gmeow:DefeaterKind`](../classes/gmeow-DefeaterKind.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:defeaterKind`](gmeow-defeaterKind.md) from [`gmeow:StandpointClaim`](../classes/gmeow-StandpointClaim.md) to [`gmeow:DefeaterKind`](../classes/gmeow-DefeaterKind.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

### Belief Revision

- **Source:** [`slices/core/inference/examples/belief-revision.ttl`](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/slices/core/inference/examples/belief-revision.ttl)

```turtle
@prefix gmeow: <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/> .
@prefix ex:    <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/examples/inference/> .
@prefix rdfs:  <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> .
@prefix xsd:   <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> .



# --- The defeater (an undercutting one) ------------------------------------- #
ex:defeaterNeverQueued a gmeow:StandpointClaim ;
    rdfs:label "Defeater: the document was never queued"@en ;
    gmeow:vantage ex:operator ;
    gmeow:observedFeature ex:propNeverQueued ;
    gmeow:observationMethod gmeow:methodDirectObservation ;
    gmeow:claimModality gmeow:unequivocal ;
    gmeow:defeaterKind gmeow:defeaterUndercutting .  # removes the warrant, not asserts the negation
```

```turtle
    rdfs:label "Defeater: a firewall rule blocked the ping"@en ;
    gmeow:vantage ex:lillith ;
    gmeow:observedFeature ex:propFirewall ;
    gmeow:observationMethod gmeow:methodDirectObservation ;
    gmeow:claimModality gmeow:unequivocal ;
    gmeow:defeaterKind gmeow:defeaterUndercutting .
```
